channel.title: Help
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Help" - I made an application for the SCP Wiki and it got accepted. I tried to make an article but it doesn’t let me. I was signed in so it should let me. Can someone help me out?

item.title: Re: Help
item.content:encoded:
I suppose it is technically a different wiki, but I have no way of knowing.

The sandbox is a different wiki. You can tell by the "member of" section of your wikidot profile; membership to the mainsite and membership to the sandbox are listed separately.

item.title: Re: Help
item.content:encoded: If you were trying to make a sandbox page, the fix is pretty simple. I ran into the same problem myself, in fact. All you have to do is go to the sandbox and find the tab where you can join the site. I suppose it is technically a different wiki, but I have no way of knowing. Hope you can get it working!

item.title: Re: Help
item.content:encoded: try signing in using the wikidot version instead of scpwiki.com

item.title: Re: Help
item.content:encoded:
What page where you trying to make? If you were logged in, there's a decent chance it was cos it was at e.g. http://www.scpwiki.com/protected:scp-5123 say (and in the 'protected' category as a result): you'll want to make a page without a colon in the url.

There's a possibility you were logged out due to a wikidot bug: the extension here would help you fix this.

(Also as a sidenote note, getting feedback before posting is highly recommended: the How to Write An SCP guide covers how you can do this)

item.title: Help
item.content:encoded:
Exactly what the title says. A message comes up saying:

Please note:

Sorry, you can not create a new page in this category. Only members of this site, site administrators and perhaps selected moderators are allowed to do it.
